page_title: HAM 1-1 AUG | Hamburger SV v Augsburg 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Rayan Philippe as he is replaced by Otto Stange (Hamburger).
90+5' That's it for today, Deniz Aytekin has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+3' Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
90+3' Now Hamburger SV have a corner.

90+1' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
90+1' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Augsburg.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexis Claude-Maurice trots off the pitch and is replaced by Uchenna Ogundu (Augsburg).

89' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal! The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

87' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Deniz Aytekin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Hamburger SV.
86' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Hamburger SV, play can continue.
85' Referee Deniz Aytekin makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Hamburger SV. Let’s see what happens!
84' That looked a certain handball by Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
84' Hamburger SV take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

83' Albert Gronbaek (Hamburger) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the right post. It would have probably ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Finn Dahmen and his brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Hamburger SV are awarded a corner kick.
81' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Deniz Aytekin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' Manuel Baum prepares a substitution. Robin Fellhauer is replaced by Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg).
80' Substitution. Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) replaces Anton Kade.
78' A cross from a corner kick by Hamburger SV is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
77' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Hamburger SV, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
75' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) attempts to test the goalkeeper after collecting a cross inside the penalty area. Luck doesn't appear to be on his side today as his attempt rattles the left post.

73' Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) climbs highest in the middle of the box after a cross from the wing, but sends a good looking header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.

70' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
69' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) inside the box.
67' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Albert Gronbaek (Hamburger) replacing Robert Glatzel.
67' It's time for a substitution. Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) comes on in place of Ransford Konigsdorffer.
66' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) misdirects his free kick from outside the box and the ball sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
64' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) makes an ugly challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee! Augsburg win a free kick.

63' CHANCE! Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
63' Hamburger SV have a corner.

63' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Hamburger SV.
62' The referee points to the corner flag and Hamburger SV will take a corner.
60' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) tries his luck from the edge of the box and scores with an accurate shot inside the left post. Robert Glatzel provided an assist for the goal.
59' It must be a yellow card. It is. Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
57' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) was too forceful with his tackle and Deniz Aytekin interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
55' Deniz Aytekin shows a yellow card to Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) for his blatant foul.

54' A sweet pass inside the box gives Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
53' Anton Kade (Augsburg) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.

50' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
49' Arthur Chaves (Augsburg) commits a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.

47' A pass into the box finds Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Daniel Heuer Fernandes denies him.
46' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Augsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Merlin Polzin has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) comes on the pitch for Philip Otele.
46' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
45+1' Referee Deniz Aytekin sees the trip by Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Augsburg win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

44' Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
43' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Deniz Aytekin saw the whole situation.
41' Philip Otele (Hamburger) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
40' The resulting set piece from Hamburger SV is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

39' Philip Otele (Hamburger) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the roof of the net. Finn Dahmen guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The ball goes out for a corner. Hamburger SV can continue in their attacking effort.

37' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) was close to scoring from the resulting free kick. He unleashed a decent strike from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper made a great save to keep him out.
36' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Hamburger SV.
34' Daniel Heuer Fernandes makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Anton Kade (Augsburg) after a cross from the side.
32' Anton Kade (Augsburg) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
30' Hamburger SV couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

29' Arthur Chaves (Augsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Deniz Aytekin no option but to blow his whistle. That's a free kick to Hamburger SV.
29' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
27' Hamburger SV are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
25' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hamburger SV comes to nothing.
22' 0 - 1 Arthur Chaves (Augsburg) wins the ball inside the penalty area after the free kick and scores with a precise shot into the bottom left corner!
22' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) makes a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul. Augsburg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
19' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
18' The ball is out of play. Hamburger SV win a corner kick.
16' Neat passing move from Augsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
14' A lofted pass into the box is met by Anton Kade (Augsburg), who rifles a shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.

12' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

10' A clever short pass gives Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
9' Great teamplay by Hamburger SV as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
5' Deniz Aytekin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger).

4' What a big chance! Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.

2' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Hamburger SV will take the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
